methodSections.heading: Curry Paste
steps: Peel the ginger and garlic and remove the stalks from the lime leaves.

Measure all the dried spices into a pan and toast over medium heat for a few minutes until they are aromatic. Keep the spices on the move in the pan by stirring or shaking the pan so they toast evenly.

Place all ingredients into a blender with a splash of oil and blend into a paste. You could also use a large pestle and mortar, but you’ll need to mince the ginger, garlic and lemongrass first. Add enough oil for a thick paste to come together. Set aside.

methodSections.heading: Curry
steps: Mince the garlic and peel and roughly chop the onion. Chop the pepper, potato, carrot and cauliflower into small bite-size chunks.
In a large saucepan, sweat the onion over a low heat for 2-3 minutes in a splash of oil. Add the garlic, stir and cook for 30 seconds then add the lemongrass, stir and cook for another 30 seconds.
Add the potato, increase the heat to medium and cook for 3 minutes. Add the peppers and carrots and continue cooking for 2 minutes.

Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute before adding 1 cup of water and the coconut milk. Add the chickpeas, green peas, cauliflower, pineapple and tofu, bring to a boil then reduce the temperature to a simmer.
Cook until the curry has reduced a bit and the vegetables have softened. Season to taste and serve with rice or noodles.
